class LRUCache:
    """
    Implementation of an LRU (Least Recently Used) Cache using a hash map 
    for O(1) access and a doubly linked list to maintain the order of usage.
    """

    def __init__(self, capacity: int):
        self.capacity = capacity
        self.cache = {}
        self.head = Node(0, 0)
        self.tail = Node(0, 0)
        self.head.next = self.tail
        self.tail.prev = self.head

    def _remove(self, node: Node):
        prev_node = node.prev
        next_node = node.next
        prev_node.next = next_node
        next_node.prev = prev_node

    def _add_to_head(self, node: Node):
        node.next = self.head.next
        node.prev = self.head
        self.head.next.prev = node
        self.head.next = node

    def get(self, key: int) -> int:
        if key in self.cache:
            node = self.cache[key]
            self._remove(node)
            self._add_to_head(node)
            return node.value
        return -1

    def put(self, key: int, value: int) -> None:
        if key in self.cache:
            self._remove(self.cache[key])
        node = Node(key, value)
        self.cache[key] = node
        self._add_to_head(node)
        if len(self.cache) > self.capacity:
            lru_node = self.tail.prev
            self._remove(lru_node)
            del self.cache[lru_node.key]

class LRUCache:
    """
    Implementation of an LRU (Least Recently Used) Cache using a hashmap (dictionary) for O(1) access 
    to cache items and a doubly linked list for maintaining the order of usage. The hashmap stores keys 
    and nodes, while the linked list keeps track of the least recently used items.
    """
    
    def __init__(self, capacity: int):
        self.capacity = capacity
        self.cache = {}
        self.head = Node(0, 0)  # Dummy head
        self.tail = Node(0, 0)  # Dummy tail
        self.head.next = self.tail
        self.tail.prev = self.head

    def _remove(self, node: Node) -> None:
        prev_node = node.prev
        next_node = node.next
        prev_node.next = next_node
        next_node.prev = prev_node

    def _add(self, node: Node) -> None:
        tail_prev = self.tail.prev
        tail_prev.next = node
        node.prev = tail_prev
        node.next = self.tail
        self.tail.prev = node

    def get(self, key: int) -> int:
        if key in self.cache:
            node = self.cache[key]
            self._remove(node)
            self._add(node)
            return node.value
        return -1

    def put(self, key: int, value: int) -> None:
        if key in self.cache:
            self._remove(self.cache[key])
        new_node = Node(key, value)
        self.cache[key] = new_node
        self._add(new_node)
        if len(self.cache) > self.capacity:
            lru_node = self.head.next
            self._remove(lru_node)
            del self.cache[lru_node.key]

class LRUCache:
    """
    A class that implements an LRU (Least Recently Used) Cache
    using a combination of a dictionary and a doubly linked list.
    This allows for O(1) time complexity for both get and put operations.
    """

    class Node:
        """A Node of the doubly linked list."""
        def __init__(self, key, value):
            self.key = key
            self.value = value
            self.prev = None
            self.next = None

    def __init__(self, capacity: int):
        self.capacity = capacity
        self.cache = {}
        self.head = self.Node(0, 0)
        self.tail = self.Node(0, 0)
        self.head.next = self.tail
        self.tail.prev = self.head

    def _remove(self, node):
        """Remove a node from the doubly linked list."""
        node.prev.next = node.next
        node.next.prev = node.prev

    def _add_to_head(self, node):
        """Add a node right after the head."""
        node.next = self.head.next
        node.prev = self.head
        self.head.next.prev = node
        self.head.next = node

    def get(self, key: int) -> int:
        """Retrieve the value of the key if the key exists, 
        otherwise return -1. Move the accessed node to the head."""
        if key in self.cache:
            node = self.cache[key]
            self._remove(node)
            self._add_to_head(node)
            return node.value
        return -1

    def put(self, key: int, value: int) -> None:
        """Insert or update the value of the key. If the cache is full, 
        remove the least recently used item before adding a new one."""
        if key in self.cache:
            node = self.cache[key]
            self._remove(node)
            node.value = value
            self._add_to_head(node)
        else:
            if len(self.cache) >= self.capacity:
                # Remove LRU from the linked list and from the cache
                lru = self.tail.prev
                self._remove(lru)
                del self.cache[lru.key]
            new_node = self.Node(key, value)
            self._add_to_head(new_node)
            self.cache[key] = new_node

class LRUCache:
    """A class implementing an LRU (Least Recently Used) Cache using a dictionary for O(1) access
    and a doubly-linked list for order tracking of the cache items."""
    
    class Node:
        """A doubly linked list node to store key-value pairs and references to previous and next nodes."""
        def __init__(self, key=0, value=0):
            self.key = key
            self.value = value
            self.prev = None
            self.next = None

    def __init__(self, capacity: int):
        self.capacity = capacity
        self.cache = {}
        self.head = self.Node()  # Dummy head
        self.tail = self.Node()  # Dummy tail
        self.head.next = self.tail
        self.tail.prev = self.head

    def _remove(self, node: Node):
        """Removes a node from the linked list."""
        prev_node = node.prev
        next_node = node.next
        prev_node.next = next_node
        next_node.prev = prev_node

    def _add_to_front(self, node: Node):
        """Adds a node to the front of the linked list (right after head)."""
        node.prev = self.head
        node.next = self.head.next
        self.head.next.prev = node
        self.head.next = node

    def get(self, key: int) -> int:
        """Returns the value of the key if present, else returns -1."""
        if key in self.cache:
            node = self.cache[key]
            self._remove(node)  # Remove from its current position
            self._add_to_front(node)  # Move to front (most recently used)
            return node.value
        return -1

    def put(self, key: int, value: int) -> None:
        """Updates the value of the key if it exists, or adds the key-value pair to the cache."""
        if key in self.cache:
            node = self.cache[key]
            self._remove(node)  # Remove old node
            node.value = value  # Update value
            self._add_to_front(node)  # Add to front
        else:
            if len(self.cache) >= self.capacity:
                # Remove the LRU item
                lru_node = self.tail.prev
                self._remove(lru_node)
                del self.cache[lru_node.key]
            new_node = self.Node(key, value)
            self._add_to_front(new_node)  # Add new node to front
            self.cache[key] = new_node  # Store reference in cache
